## Purpose

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Assurance boundary

State which guarantee, interoperability surface, or documented limitation this
change affects. If it does not affect one, say so.

## Verification

List the tests, fixtures, type checks, or manual checks that establish the
change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for externally observable behavior.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible SDK or format change.
- [ ] I included specification, schema, and conformance-fixture updates for any
      protocol change.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private model responses, chain-of-thought, or
      sensitive evidence.
- [ ] I ran the applicable checks documented in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
